lead.headline: Sadiq is questionable; the flex is still a point off
lead.deck: Your only tight end was limited all week. Andrews is free and has no game status. Downs still belongs in the flex, and Keenan Allen's questionable tag leans the same way. The Ravens lost Hendrickson.
lead.body: Kenyon Sadiq finished the week as he started it: limited, three days running, with the back he hurt on a diving touchdown catch, and the Jets list him as questionable. He is the only tight end on this roster and no bench player can cover the slot, so the plan stays on the wire and moves to Sunday morning. If he is inactive at 09:30, add Mark Andrews, a free agent with no game status, and drop Carnell Tate. The flex is undone for a fourth edition: Bhayshul Tuten is in it, ESPN prefers Josh Downs by a point, and a coin flip goes to the projection. Friday added one thing on Downs' side, since Keenan Allen is now questionable. Downs locks at 07:30 Sunday in London. The Ravens D/ST fell to 7.0 after Trey Hendrickson was ruled out, a point below the free Bills; that is a coin flip on a seat that changed hands Wednesday, and it holds. Across the matchup, Team 13 still start DeVonta Smith and Rachaad White, both ruled out, which is why ESPN has you at 68%. That number shrinks the moment they set a lineup.
